title: An on-map, Runescape like combat system. Rpg Maker MV

posts.author: oliveric
posts.body:
Hey everybody!
I'm wondering if somebody here knows how to set up an on map, clicker type combat system?
I know that I need an abs, like chrono engine, and for now that's the one I'm going with!
My dream scenario would be if somebody could write me a litteral step-by-step guide of how to do it.
But any help on any part of it would be greatly appreciated!
My game is an rpg, quite big world, It's called The Songs of Everdale.
I just want the combat to be like this:
You see the mob and click it.
Your character starts then auto-attacking it in the speed that the skills and levels and current weilded weapon and items dictate.
Each hit deals out a specific damage that in turn give you xp.
The mobs also auto-attack in the same way.
So I'm guessing the combat itself should be quite plug and play, just a standard common event maybe to call on when clicking the enemy/mob.
And that the "hard" stuff might be including all the variables that a specific weapon for example could add to change the combat, like the attackspeed and damage and so on.
But i "smell" that this doesnt maybe have to be so very hard. But I am still looking for how to do it in an easy way.
Does anybody know how to do this?
Best regards, Oliver!
I'm running Rpg Maker MV and I have both a mac and a pc that I can use to program this.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
oliveric said:
But i "smell" that this doesnt maybe have to be so very hard.
Click to expand...
wrong
Depending on available time and personal experience, programming an ABS usually takes up to two or three years for a good programmer - and is anything but easy.
And eventing an ABS can only be done by accepting a lot of limitations.
so it is already difficult to do when you know yourself how to do something - writing a tutorial on how to do something like that is even more work and has more problems on its own.
But if you really want to learn that, you need to start by learning programming and logic structures.
and then come back here for the next step after you know how to design a program - which can take up to a year of learning for most people.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Yeah, MMO combat is not something that's "Just slap this plugin in and go". I'd even argue you shouldn't be using RPG maker for such a thing in the first place.

posts.author: oliveric
posts.body:
Oh okay wow. Does this even apply to making the chrono engine do this?
The programming an ABS taking 2+ years, 3 years?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
I haven't used chrono engine, but as the name implies, I'm fairly sure it's based on chrono trigger's battle system, which is turn based as far as I'm aware. What you're looking for is essentially a tick based cooldown for each individual skill that also gives exp based on usage.
Now as I said, I haven't used Chrono engine, but this doesn't sound like something you can just have a random battle plugin do. More like something that requires a custom plugin, which is very likely to go into the hundreds of dollars, if not more.
A different engine might be better suited, instead of trying to hamfist something into rpg make that just isn't made for such a thing.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
SGHarlekin said:
I haven't used chrono engine, but as the name implies, I'm fairly sure it's based on chrono trigger's battle system, which is turn based as far as I'm aware. What you're looking for is essentially a tick based cooldown for each individual skill that also gives exp based on usage.
Click to expand...
Chrono Engine has a Chrono Trigger battle system clone, but also an ABS mode. You can use it for any on-map battle system. It has a built in Zelda clone, but with some tweaks you can make a top-down shooter, tower defense, RTS, what have you.
However, you are not going to find a lot of help with Chrono Engine (or other ABS plugins either), often I'm the only person replying to CE help threads, so if I'm not availble then, well, you may be on your own.
That said, you CAN replicate the Runescape battle system, but be ready to get your hands dirty writing and editing CE code.

Play the Chrono Engine (or Cross Engine) ABS demos. Does it already have the gameplay you want? If not then you are going to have to add or edit code to get it to do what you want.
You can try Pheonix KageDesu's ABS plugin too. The demo is free but the plugin is paid, but at least he's active and you can ask him for help (I don't know how responsive he is though).

posts.author: Noxyy
posts.body:
If you want a barebones version that just starts attacking as soon as you click an enemy, that's not hard at all to make, it's all just variables and checking if an event is at X/Y,
here's a little demo
using a custom script to track mouse X/Y in real time.
I once
toyed with this idea for a prototype using dice rolls
, but rpgmaker is really not the best tool for this, you will run into a lot of issues that will require some amount of javascript. (PS: The controls are C for jump, F to pick up the weird jump thing, Z to interact/pick items, arrows to move)
But then what is the point of using Rpgmaker if you're going to write code any way...
